name: Hugh
source:
‘We’ll meet again. Surely, it won’t be long…’

A mysterious young man who comes and disappears as he pleases. He seems to know a lot about the secrets of ‘a certain thing’; it’s unknown as to whether he is friend or foe.

[From [url=https://sakura52-blog.tumblr.com/post/174361157222/psychedelica-of-the-ashen-hawk-character-profiles]Sakura52's blog[/url]]
